summary: BiomX Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to update the maximum aggregate offering price for its at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering under an existing Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The filing amends prior supplements to reflect a new limit of $5,061,000 available for sale, as per General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, given an $19.25M non-affiliate public float. Approximately $1.38M has been sold to date. The stock trades on NYSE American under PHGE. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation.
